top_signals.title: The Highland tourist tax: Is Scotland pricing out whisky tourists?
top_signals.summary: The latest available data from the Scottish Tourism Economic Activity Monitor in Scotland (STEAM) shows that between 2012 and 2024, visitor numbers to the Highlands increased 82 per cent to 9.4m.
